meter.h2: See how much light gets in
meter.sim: Simulation until our shade board photos are shot
meter.body: Each chip is drawn at the share of visible light a film lets in. 70 is the lightest on this board and 5 is the darkest. Tap a shade to start a build.
meter.chip_aria: {vlt} percent light in, start a build
meter.law: Under NRS 484D.440, front side windows must let in at least 35% of light, with a 7% tolerance, counting film and glass together. Rear and back glass has no darkness limit when the vehicle has outside mirrors on both sides. Windshield tint is allowed on the top strip only, and it cannot be red or amber.

closing.lead: Tell us the car and the look you want, or start a build first and we will pick it up from there.
